artworks.title: Les Cigarettes de camphre
artworks.description: In the image, two men are depicted facing each other in profile. The man on the left is leaning slightly forward, with one hand on his hip and the other partially visible. He has a thin face with prominent cheekbones, a sharp chin, and is smoking a cigarette. He wears a top hat, a suit, and a bowtie. The man on the right has a round face, is also smoking a cigarette, and is holding a walking stick. He wears a coat with visible buttons. The background is plain with sketching marks, and there is text above the scene stating "Les Beaux Jours de la Vie."

artworks.title: Un Hommage filial
artworks.description: The image shows two people visible from the waist up. On the left is a child holding a piece of paper with a sketched figure on it, looking at a man on their right. The child has short, wavy hair and expressive facial features. The man beside the child is standing slightly bent forward, gazing at the drawing. He has a receding hairline with strands of hair remaining on the back and sides of his head, along with prominent eyebrows and a sharply defined nose. The man is dressed in a dark suit with a shirt underneath, with one hand holding a cloth. The child appears to be wearing a simple, dark top. The background consists of a lightly sketched shaded area encompassing the figures, which fades into what seems to be a backdrop of text.

artworks.title: Un Chapeau neuf
artworks.description: Three men are pictured from the waist up in a triangular arrangement. The man at the center faces forward and holds a top hat, while the other two face him from the sides, each wearing a top hat. The man in the center has a long nose and a serious expression, with slicked-back hair visible under his hat. The man on the left has a receding hairline and short hair, wearing a patterned jacket with arms extended. The man on the right also has a pronounced nose and sideburns, matching the Victorian style, under his top hat. All are dressed in typical 19th-century fashion with high collars. The background is simple, shaded, emphasizing the figures. Text in the foreground reads "UN CHAPEAU NEUF" with additional text below.

artworks.title: A la porte Saint-Martin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theater or performance setting inside a crowded venue. The scene shows an individual holding a spoon and a bowl, leaning in with astonishment towards the stage. A large backdrop filled with an audience is visible. The detailed expressions and intricate cross-hatching lend drama and tension. The composition captures the person's reaction and the engaged audience. The use of line work and shading creates depth and movement, enhancing the lively atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Une Attention délicate
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, viewed from the waist up. The man on the left is standing and is partially turned toward the woman. He has short, wavy hair and prominent facial features, including a pronounced nose and deep-set eyes. He wears a jacket and holds a cane in his hand. The woman on the right is seated and facing slightly away from the man. She has smooth, dark hair, parted in the middle, and tied back, with a headscarf framing her face. Her expression is contemplative. She is wearing a form-fitting dress with long sleeves. Both individuals are positioned around an intricately designed shawl or fabric that the woman is holding. The background is lightly textured, giving a soft contrast to the detailed figures in the foreground, and the artwork features some text elements visible above and below the image.

artworks.title: Comment on devient un grand mathématicien
artworks.description: The image displays the upper bodies of multiple individuals, with two main figures highlighted. One person is facing away from the viewer, writing on a chalkboard, while the other is facing forward but turned slightly towards the chalkboard, gesturing with both hands. The background includes additional figures in a likely academic setting.

artworks.title: Comme quoi la gymnastique forme les membres...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of boys watching a gymnastics exercise. One boy is hanging upside down on gymnastic bars while others observe. In the background, a figure supervises. The scene is outdoors with faint sketches of trees and buildings. The drawing features exaggerated features and facial expressions, resembling a caricature with stylized lines.

artworks.title: Comment on décide un jeune homme a venir...
artworks.description: The image shows three figures from about the waist up. The central figure is a person gripping the ear of a younger person to their right. The central person has a lean face with sharp features and is wearing a dark cap and coat. To their left is another adult figure, bent slightly forward with their head angled down, wearing a long coat and a brimmed hat that covers their eyes. The young individual being held has messy, curly hair and an exaggerated expression. They are dressed in a loose-fit garment, and their facial features show wide eyes and an open mouth. In the background, the scene is set outdoors with hints of buildings in sketchy outlines, a tree with foliage on one side, and a group of children or figures on the far right, partially obscured and standing in a circle. The overall setting suggests an urban or suburban environment.

artworks.title: Jeunes collégiens... lavant jusqu'a leur dictionnaire latin
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing shoulder to shoulder. The person on the left is an older individual wearing glasses, holding an open book with both hands. Their hair is slightly disheveled under a cap, and they wear a dark loose garment. The two individuals on the right are younger, wearing dark coats and tall hats. Both have expressions of attentiveness. In the background, there are shelves of books and buildings with windows and rooftops.

artworks.title: Je n'y redescends plus!... je crois...
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a bathhouse setting. The figure on the left is hunched over with hands around the upper arms, while the figure on the right stands upright. Both figures have exaggerated facial features and are dressed down to their waist. Additional figures can be seen in the background, including one sitting covered by a towel, another submerged in water, and a third figure popping up from the water. The setting features wooden beams and panels, and the style is illustrative with etching-style shading.

artworks.title: Attention, Gargouillet, v'la le bourgeois qui passe...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted partially, from the waist up, as they are engaged in the act of bathing in a body of water. The person on the left is seated with their knees visible and has water pouring over their head, hands positioned on their head as though they are washing their hair. Their facial features are not clearly defined, but they have short, light-colored hair that is drenched. The second person stands or kneels to the right, with black, wet hair hanging over their face. They are shirtless, and the lower part of their body is submerged in water. The background features a sketched outline of buildings and two figures walking along the shore; one is a man wearing a tall hat and holding a cane, and the other is a woman with a parasol.

artworks.title: Un Abus de confiance
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking. He appears older, with a prominent nose and slightly protruding belly. He wears a top hat, a cloth draped around his waist, and holds a stick or staff. The background is a landscape with a tree on the left, a body of water, hills, and distant buildings. Small figures can be seen near the shoreline.

artworks.title: Bains de Femmes
artworks.description: There are several women and a child in a body of water. One woman with short hair is wading, while another woman in a dress holds a child above the water. Another woman interacts with the child. In the background, there is a wooden structure with people climbing down a ladder. The expressions on the faces suggest a communal and familial activity. The drawing captures a moment of interaction and care in a bathhouse setting.

artworks.title: En pleine eau
artworks.description: There is an illustration of a scene on a body of water depicted from a slightly elevated angle. The image shows a small boat with two women and one man seemingly losing control. Another figure in the water appears agitated. The horizon line is visible in the upper portion of the image, with faint hills or landforms in the background. The trees and land are rendered with light, loose brushstrokes, giving a sense of movement. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of black, white, and gray, emphasizing the figures in the boat and in the water. The figures nearer to the viewer are outlined with darker lines.

artworks.title: Entre deux plongeons
artworks.description: This drawing depicts several figures in loose garments in a bathhouse setting. Some figures are standing and one is bending over. One figure on the right is drinking from a vessel, leaning against a round table with drinking vessels. The background features arches indicating an interior space. The image is done in a monochromatic palette with a drafting style reminiscent of 19th-century European art.

artworks.title: Les Baigneuses prudentes
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals in the water at different depths. The person on the left is seated, showing only their shoulders and above, with arms resting on a ledge and wearing a knit cap. The middle person stands waist-deep, holding floatation devices under each arm, wearing a checkered dress and headscarf. The person on the right also stands waist-deep, with arms resting inside a large inflated ring around their midsection, short hair hidden under a cap. In the background, there is a tall wall with engraved patterns, and the water ripples around the individuals.

artworks.title: Ou peut conduire la lecture du Constitutionnel!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person reading a newspaper amidst an abstract landscape. The scene includes a figure standing in a water-filled area surrounded by tree-like structures or rocks. The figure is dressed in a suit and top hat, reading a large newspaper titled "LE CONSTITUTIONNEL." The background features textured shades and forms suggesting foliage or a natural setting. Strong contrasts of black and white highlight the central figure against the lighter environment, showcasing solitude and engrossment in reading in an unusual environment.

artworks.title: Le Danger de... visiter un site par trop sauvage
artworks.description: The image features three men in an outdoor, wooded environment. The man in the center is standing, wearing a top hat and a dark suit with tails. He has a serious expression and his hair is not visible. The man on the left is slightly crouched and wears a dark suit with a bowler hat. The man on the right is hunched over, assisting the central figure with his clothing. He wears light-colored trousers, a dark jacket, and a hat with a cloth. The background consists of sketch-like trees.

artworks.title: Inconvénient pour un propriétaire de ne pas...
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a slightly bent-forward position with one hand on their head, lifting a hat. The person has exaggerated facial features with a worried or surprised expression. Their hair is short and dark, with the hat perched atop it. They are wearing a dark jacket over a lighter shirt, striped pants, and boots. Around their torso is a sash or band. They are holding a satchel or net in one hand. At their feet is a large bear trap, open and ready to snap. The background shows a rocky and dense forest area with tall trees and bushes. In the foreground is a dirt path or clearing where the person stands over the trap. The artwork is monochromatic, using shades of grey.

artworks.title: Que nous sommes bêtes d'avoir une peur pareille...
artworks.description: The image features two figures towards the left side of the frame. The figure on the left appears to be a man, standing upright, dressed in formal attire. Next to him, a woman is leaning back with her body, her head turned slightly to the left. Her face is partially obscured by her hair or a veil being blown by the wind. She wears a long, flowing dress. In front of them is a figure, possibly a scarecrow or mannequin, positioned awkwardly in a wheat field with its arms stretched upwards and outward, wearing a hat and flowing garments similar to the woman's attire. The background shows a tree with blowing leaves, a field, and an open landscape.

artworks.title: Comme quoi, au village, la vertu la plus grêlée...
artworks.description: This is an image showing a formal presentation scene. Several figures are gathered around a central point where one person is presenting something to a seated individual. The presenter is handing an ornate object to the seated individual, who is leaning forward slightly. People in the background are observing the exchange. The setting seems formal or ceremonial from the clothing style and the attentive crowd. The composition captures a moment of interaction surrounded by an interested audience.

artworks.title: Quand on fait ses foins...
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a figure jumping over a worker using a scythe in a field. The drawing includes a figure in formal attire, possibly a gentleman with a top hat, reacting in surprise to a laborer working with a scythe. The background features an open field with trees in the distance and a cloudy sky. Text at the top reads "PASTORALES" with additional text under the image adding a narrative element about rural life. The drawing is in black and white, with texture and shading depicting depth and movement.

artworks.title: Avantages des terrasses italiennes...
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals seated closely together on an outdoor terrace. The man on the left is seated on a wooden chair and has a concentrated or annoyed expression. He is wearing a patterned vest over a light-colored shirt and trousers. Next to him, another man is seated with closed eyes and an expression of discomfort. He has short, dark hair combed back and is wearing a long-sleeved shirt with a high collar. The third individual on the right appears to be batting away a swarm of insects with a hat. The background shows buildings faintly visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Je croyais que c'était plus amusant que ça...
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a garden. He is holding a watering can in one hand and lifting a cloth to his forehead with the other hand. The man has a round face, wears glasses, and has disheveled hair. He is wearing a coat over a shirt and pants. The garden around him contains leafy plants and blooming flowers. In the background, there is a sketch of a fence and trees.
